summary: To speed up runs against cloud servers, run Ansible from a management node inside the cloud provider rather than from your laptop.
questions: Ansible is slow against my EC2 instances from my laptop, what can I do?

answer_card.title: Run Ansible close to cloud hosts
answer_card.answer_md: Don't manage a cloud fleet over the internet from a laptop. Run Ansible from a **management node inside the same cloud/region**, which cuts latency for every SSH round trip.
